blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cultural heritage aggregators provide access to millions of digitized items. Yet their catalog records often contain sparse, heterogeneous metadata, with associated media links that may not lead to accessible images. Structuring and validating these resources for multimodal AI research can support reproducible experimentation. To this end, we present CHICO (Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects), a multimodal dataset derived from Europeana that brings together curated catalog fields, images, and contextual information to support evidence-grounded description generation while retaining the original Europeana records. It comprises more than 60,000 cultural heritage records with associated images. Although originally developed for that purpose, it can also support multimodal information retrieval, metadata enrichment, and evidence-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 文化遗产集合器提供数百万个数字化物品。 然而,它们的目录记录往往包含稀少、内容繁杂的元数据,而与之相关的媒体链接可能无法获取图像。 为多式人工智能研究寻找和验证这些资源,可以支持可复制的实验。 为此,我们提出CHICO(文化遗产图像和目录对象),这是一个从欧洲a 衍生出来的多模式数据集,汇集了整理的目录域,图像,以及背景信息,以支持基于证据的描述生成,同时保留欧洲a原始记录. 它包括6万多份文化遗产记录以及相关的图像. 虽然它最初是为了这一目的开发的,但它也可以支持多式联运信息检索、元数据丰富和循证评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Museums, libraries, and archives have digitized millions of cultural heritage items, making their collections increasingly accessible through aggregators such as Europeana ( Isaac and Haslhofer, 2013 ) and Brasiliana Museus ( Siqueira et al., 2022b ) .
These collections bring together records from different institutions, reflecting diverse cataloging practices, metadata structures, and completeness levels.
In this context, catalog descriptions help visitors discover and understand cultural heritage items, while their availability and level of detail reflect the diversity of collections and cataloging practices.
Alongside catalog metadata, associated images and contextual notes can offer complementary perspectives.
Together, these sources enable multimodal approaches, including generating textual descriptions grounded in the information associated with each item.
blocks.zh:
博物馆、图书馆和档案馆已经将数百万件文化遗产物品数字化,通过诸如Europeana(Isaac and Haslhofer,2013年)和Baliana Museus(Siqueira等人,2022年b)等汇集器,其藏品越来越容易取用。
这些汇编汇集了不同机构的记录,反映了不同的编目做法、元数据结构和完整性水平。
在这方面,目录描述有助于参观者发现和了解文化遗产项目,而其可用性和详细程度反映了收藏和目录做法的多样性。
除了目录元数据,相关的图像和背景说明可以提供互补的视角。
这些来源加在一起,就能够采用多式方法,包括根据与每个项目有关的资料编写文字说明。

blocks.en:
The availability and structure of these information sources vary considerably across cultural heritage records.
Catalog information, including titles, dates, and creators, is documented at different levels of detail across collections.
Similarly, media links do not always provide access to usable images.
Institutional descriptions, when available, range from brief statements to detailed curatorial texts and may contain information not represented in other metadata fields or images.
Consequently, treating these descriptions as ground truth for generation or evaluation may introduce information that cannot be verified against the available evidence.
Furthermore, Europeana records follow the Europeana Data Model (EDM), combining nested structures, multilingual values, and URI-based references ( Isaac and Haslhofer, 2013 ) .
Bringing these information sources together for multimodal approaches involves selecting relevant catalog fields, handling heterogeneous metadata, and verifying the usability of associated images.
blocks.zh:
这些信息来源的提供情况和结构因文化遗产记录而大相径庭。
包括标题、日期和创作者在内的目录信息,在不同收集中以不同的详细程度记录。
同样,媒体链接也并不总是提供可用图像的获取途径。
机构说明(如有)从简要说明到详细的目录文本,可能包含其他元数据领域或图像中没有的信息。
因此,将这些描述作为生成或评价的基础真相,可能会产生无法根据现有证据加以核实的信息。
此外,Europeana记录遵循Europeana数据模型(EDM),结合了嵌入式结构,多语种价值,以及基于URI的参考文献(Isaac and Haslhofer, 2013.).
将这些信息来源汇集起来,以便采用多模式方法,包括选择相关的目录字段、处理不同的元数据并核实相关图像的可用性。

blocks.en:
CHICO (Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects) is a multimodal dataset derived from Europeana records to support evidence-grounded description generation.
It brings together curated catalog fields, associated images, and contextual information while preserving the original Europeana records.
Its structure provides a consistent representation of these complementary sources, supporting reproducible experimentation and potential reuse in other multimodal approaches.
The dataset comprises 60,397 cultural heritage records from 74 providers, with 83,852 images verified as decodable.
Construction and analysis code are publicly available; 1 1 1 https://github.com/AI-Unicamp/heritage-data-hub the dataset artifacts are released on Zenodo Oliveira and Costa (2026) . 2 2 2 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23954726
blocks.zh:
CHICO(Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects)是一款从欧洲记录中衍生出来的多式数据集,用于支持以证据为基础的描述生成.
它汇集了被整理的目录字段,相关图像,以及背景信息,同时保留了欧洲原始记录.
其结构始终如一地代表了这些补充来源,支持了可再生试验和可能在其他多式方法中的再利用。
数据集由74个提供商的60 397个文化遗产记录组成,83 852个图像经核实为可解码.
建筑和分析代码公开; 1 1 1 https://github.com/AI-Unicamp/heritage-data-hub 兹诺多·奥利维拉和科斯塔(2026年)发布了数据集文物。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 illustrates the construction of CHICO, from Europeana collections to the resulting dataset.
The process involves curating records and associated media, structuring catalog information alongside images, and incorporating contextual information by retrieving and ranking entity notes.
The resulting records retain the institutional descriptions separately as references for subsequent use.
blocks.zh:
图1显示CHICO的结构,从欧洲收集到由此产生的数据集。
这一过程涉及整理记录和相关媒体,与图像一起构建目录信息,通过检索和排名实体说明纳入背景信息。
由此产生的记录保留了机构说明,作为日后使用的参考。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Construction of CHICO from Europeana collections into catalog fields, role-labeled images, and ranked retrieval notes, with the institution description retained as an evaluation reference.
blocks.zh: 图1:将欧洲收藏的CHICO构建成目录领域,角色标签图像,以及排名检索说明,机构描述保留作为评价参考.

blocks.en: This work makes three main contributions: a curated multimodal dataset of 60,397 Europeana records with associated images, catalog fields, and contextual notes, while preserving the original records and their provenance; a documented construction pipeline with training, validation, and test splits designed to prevent overlap among related records; and a characterization of the dataset’s composition, languages, and catalog-field coverage across collections.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出了三个主要贡献:一个由60 397人组成的多模式数据集。 Europeana记录包含相关的图像、目录字段和背景笔记,同时保留原始记录及其出处;一个有记录的建筑管道,配备培训、验证和测试分块,旨在防止相关记录之间的重叠;以及对数据集的构成、语言和目录字段覆盖的描述。

blocks.en: The following sections review related work (Section 2 ), describe CHICO and its construction (Section 3 ), present its availability (Section 4 ), discuss limitations (Section 5 ), and provide concluding remarks (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 以下各节审查有关工作(第2节),描述CHICO及其构造(第3节),介绍其可用性(第4节),讨论局限性(第5节)并作总结发言(第6节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Existing resources support vision–language research on cultural heritage items, addressing different tasks and annotation formats.
DEArt provides European art images with object and pose annotations for detection and scene understanding ( Reshetnikov et al., 2023 ) .
EMA introduces a Brazilian cultural heritage image dataset with annotated images from museum collections, supporting automated metadata annotation through image classification de Oliveira et al. (2022) .
For artwork captioning, Cioni et al. (2023) explore diffusion-based data augmentation, while Castellano et al. (2024) combine vision–language models and language-based methods to generate and refine textual descriptions. Bongini et al. (2023) investigate visual question answering by combining visual information with contextual knowledge about artworks.
Other approaches explore multimodal retrieval of iconographic concepts using the Iconclass classification system ( Banar et al., 2021 ; Santini et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
现有资源支持关于文化遗产项目的远景-语言研究,处理不同的任务和说明格式。
DEArt为欧洲艺术影像提供有物体并作说明以进行探测和场景理解(Reshetnikov等,2023.).
EMA引入了巴西文化遗产图像数据集,其中附有博物馆收藏的注解图像,通过图像分类de Oliveira等人(2022年)支持自动元数据注释.
Cioni等人(2023年)在艺术标题方面探讨了基于传播的数据扩充,而Castellano等人(2024年)将视觉-语言模型和基于语言的方法结合起来,生成并完善了文字描述。 Bongini等人(2023年)调查视觉问题,将视觉信息与艺术背景知识结合起来。
其他方法则探索利用Iconclass分类系统对图标概念进行多模式检索(Banar等,2021;Santini等,2023.).

blocks.en:
Digital aggregation initiatives bring together cultural heritage records from different institutions, reflecting diverse cataloging practices and metadata structures.
Europeana and Brasiliana Museus illustrate different approaches to aggregating and providing access to digital cultural heritage collections Isaac and Haslhofer (2013) ; Siqueira et al. (2022b) .
Europeana uses the Europeana Data Model (EDM) to represent aggregated records, incorporating Dublin Core metadata terms and linked entities Isaac and Haslhofer (2013) ; Dublin Core Metadata Initiative (2020) .
In Brazil, the Tainacan platform supports the management and publication of digital museum collections, while Brasiliana Museus uses metadata mapping and aggregation to bring together collections from different institutions Siqueira et al. (2022a) .
blocks.zh:
数字汇总举措汇集了不同机构的文化遗产记录,反映了不同的编目做法和元数据结构。
Europeana和Baliana Museus说明了汇总和提供数字文化遗产收藏的各种办法。
Europeana使用欧洲数据模型(EDM)代表汇总记录,包括都柏林核心元数据术语和关联实体Isaac和Haslhofer(2013年);都柏林核心元数据倡议(2020年)。
在巴西,Tainacan平台支持数字博物馆藏品的管理和出版,而Baliana Museus则使用元数据映射和汇总来汇集来自不同机构Siqueira等(2022a)的藏品.

blocks.en:
Research involving these resources has explored approaches to semantic enrichment and computational cataloging. Koch et al. (2021) investigate the use of semantic vocabularies and image analysis to improve the description and retrieval of historical images, while Domingo et al. (2020) combine visual recognition with semantic integration into Europeana. Abele et al. (2026) examine vision–language models for archival image cataloging, comparing generated descriptions with human-authored texts.
Institutional descriptions provide valuable curatorial knowledge, although their content may extend beyond the evidence available in associated metadata or images ( Malevé, 2021 ; Hanley et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
涉及这些资源的研究探讨了语义浓缩和计算分类的方法。 科赫等编. (2021)调查使用语义词汇和图像分析来改进历史图像的描述和检索,而多明戈等(2020年)将视觉识别与语义融合到欧洲a. 阿贝勒等. (2026年)审查用于档案图像编目的视觉-语言模型,将所生成的描述与由人类撰写的文本进行比较.
机构描述提供了宝贵的教程知识,尽管其内容可能超出相关元数据或图像中可用的证据(Malevé,2021;Hanley等,2021.).

blocks.en: CHICO takes cultural heritage records as the unit of analysis, bringing together curated catalog fields, associated images, and contextual evidence while preserving original Europeana provenance.
blocks.zh: CHICO将文化遗产记录作为分析单位,在保留欧洲原始出处的同时,汇集了被整理的目录领域,相关图像以及背景证据.

blocks.en: 3 The CHICO Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 CHICO 数据集

blocks.en:
The integration of catalog metadata, visual information, and contextual sources underpins CHICO’s multimodal structure.
Derived from Europeana, the dataset retains the original records alongside curated information, representing these complementary sources.
Its construction involves selecting and processing records, validating associated images, and organizing information for subsequent experimental use.
blocks.zh:
分类元数据、视觉信息和背景来源的整合是CHICO多式联运结构的基础。
数据集取自Europeana, 保留了原始记录和资料,代表这些补充来源。
其构建涉及选择和处理记录,验证相关图像,以及组织信息供后续实验使用.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en:
The dataset was constructed from a local harvest of approximately 33.5 million Europeana records, collected without topical restrictions and filtered for openly licensed content and declared media availability.
Each record was retrieved in its complete Europeana Data Model (EDM) representation and normalized to facilitate data management and subsequent processing.
From this collection, 100,000 records were randomly sampled, without stratification by provider, language, or item type.
blocks.zh:
数据集是根据大约3 350万欧洲记录的当地收成建造的,在没有专题限制的情况下收集,并过滤公开许可的内容和宣布的媒体可用性。
每一记录都在其完整的Europeana数据模型(EDM)代表中检索,并实现正常化,以便利数据管理和随后的处理。
从这一集中,对10万张记录进行了随机抽样,没有按提供者、语言或物品类型进行分层。

blocks.en:
The final research sample was also selected by verifying the usability of associated images.
Media files were downloaded and checked for successful decoding as raster images.
Only records with at least one successfully decoded image were retained, yielding 60,397 records with 83,852 images from 74 providers (84.8% single-image; 15.2% multi-image).
This validation step also influenced the sample composition, as collections whose media links resolve to decodable images were more likely to be retained than those linking to viewer pages or packaged scans.
blocks.zh:
通过核实相关图像的可用性,还选定了最后的研究样本。
媒体文件被下载和检查,以成功解码为光栅图像.
仅保留了至少一个成功解码图像的记录,产生了60 397个记录,来自74个提供者的83 852个图像(84.8%为单相;15.2%为多相相)。
这一验证步骤也影响了样本组成,因为其媒体链接到可解码图像的分辨率的集合比那些连接到取景器页面或被打包扫描的集合更容易被保留.

blocks.en:
To characterize the dataset’s composition, we classified records into broad item categories based on their cataloged types, considering both source-language and English representations (Figure 2 ).
Natural-history specimens form the largest group and already represented approximately 40% of the initial random sample; their share rises after image validation because these providers more frequently expose media links that resolve to decodable images.
Consequently, the resulting set is a fixed, image-validated research sample rather than a balanced or representative sample of the broader Europeana collection.
blocks.zh:
为了说明数据集的组成情况,我们根据记录的编目类型,将记录分为广泛的项目类别,同时考虑来源语言和英语表述(图2)。
自然-历史标本组成了最大的组,已经占了最初随机标本的约40%;其份额在图像验证后会上升,因为这些提供者更经常地暴露出那些决心去解码图像的媒体链接.
因此,所产生的一组是固定的、经图像验证的研究样本,而不是更广泛的欧洲a收集的平衡或有代表性的样本。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Distribution of object categories across the 60,397 records.
blocks.zh: 图 2:在60,397个记录中分发对象类别.

blocks.en:
The catalog records are multilingual, reflecting the diversity of the contributing collections.
English is the most frequently declared catalog language, alongside substantial non-English material.
Catalog fields are preserved in their source languages, with English representations included when available.
blocks.zh:
编目记录是多语种的,反映了贡献藏品的多样性.
英语是最常被公布的目录语言,此外还有大量非英语材料.
Catalog字段以源语言保存,在有英文说明时包括英文说明.

blocks.en: To minimize information leakage across experimental subsets, we grouped related records into connected components and assigned them together to training (80%), validation (10%), and test (10%) partitions.
blocks.zh: 为了尽量减少实验子集的信息泄漏,我们将相关记录分组为连接组件,并把它们分配给培训(80%)、验证(10%)和测试(10%)分区。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multimodal Record Structure
blocks.zh: 3.2 多式联运记录结构

blocks.en:
CHICO’s multimodal structure brings together catalog metadata, associated images, and contextual information for each cultural heritage item.
This structure is defined as E = ( M , I , R , d ref ) , E=\bigl(M,\,I,\,R,\,d^{\mathrm{ref}}\bigr), (1) where M M contains curated catalog fields, I I represents the associated images and their roles, R R contains contextual notes selected from related entities referenced by the record, and d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} denotes the institutional description when available.
The original Europeana record is also preserved, maintaining access to the source metadata.
For evidence-grounded description generation, M M , I I , and R R constitute the designated supporting evidence, while d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} is retained separately for comparison and excluded from generation inputs.
blocks.zh:
CHICO的多模式结构汇集了每个文化遗产项目的目录元数据、相关图像和背景资料。
这一结构的定义是:E=(M, I, R, d ref ), E=\bigl (M,\, I,\, R,\,\, d^{\mathrm{ref}}\bigr), (1) M 包含被编译的目录域, I 代表关联的图像及其作用, R R R 包含从记录所引用的相关实体中选取的上下文注释, d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} 表示在有可用时的机构描述.
原始的Europeana记录也保存了下来,维持了对源元数据的访问.
对于基于证据的描述生成,M M, I 和 R R 构成指定的佐证证据,而 d ref d^{\-mathrm{ref}} 则被单独保留以进行比较,并被排除在生成输入之外.

blocks.en:
The selection of catalog fields was informed by an examination of 1,000 randomly sampled Europeana records, considering field availability, multilingual representations, and their relevance to describing cultural heritage items ( Isaac and Haslhofer, 2013 ) .
This analysis guided the definition of the curated Cultural Heritage Object (CHO) fields, prioritizing information associated with the items themselves rather than administrative metadata.
Field selection considered descriptive relevance alongside availability, retaining information such as provenance, material, and extent even when less frequently recorded.
The object-level fields in M M include title, type, creator, date, period, place, subject, material, size, and ownership history.
The distribution of catalog information differs considerably across cultural heritage categories (Figure 3 a).
blocks.zh:
对1 000个随机抽取的欧洲记录的检查为目录字段的选择提供了依据,其中考虑到实地可用性、多语种表述及其与文化遗产项目描述的相关性(Isaac和Haslhofer,2013年)。
这一分析指导了文化遗产主题领域的定义,优先考虑与项目本身有关的信息,而不是行政元数据。
外地选择既考虑到描述性的相关性,也考虑到可用性,保留诸如出处、材料和程度等信息,即使记录较少。
MM中的对象级字段包括标题,类型,创建者,日期,期限,地点,主题,材料,大小,以及所有者历史等.
各类文化遗产的目录信息分布差别很大(图3a)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) Coverage of curated catalog fields by object category. (b) Institutional descriptions ( d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} ) by object category.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 按对象类别分列的编目栏目覆盖率。 (b) 按对象类别分列的机构说明。

blocks.en:
Associated images ( I I ) are assigned roles that distinguish object views from details, labels, mounts, and ambiguous frames.
Records with a single image are treated as object views; records with multiple images are labeled automatically so that later use can separate appearance evidence from text-bearing or non-object frames.
blocks.zh:
相关图像(I I)被指定角色,将对象视图与细节,标签,挂载,和模棱两可的帧区分开来.
具有单一图像的记录被作为对象视图处理;具有多个图像的记录被自动贴上标签,以便后期使用可以将外观证据从有文本或非对象框中分离出.

blocks.en:
Contextual information ( R R ) comes from descriptive notes of related entities referenced by the record—concepts, places, agents, and timespans—rather than from the curated catalog fields in M M .
Within each record, candidate notes are retrieved with BGE-M3 and reranked with BGE-reranker-v2-m3 Chen et al. (2024) , guided by M M , so that more relevant notes are ordered first.
The ranked list is then filtered to avoid repeating information already stated in those fields; when no suitable notes remain, R R is left empty.
blocks.zh:
背景资料(R R )来自记录中提到的相关实体的描述性说明——概念、地点、代理人和时间跨度,而不是来自MM的编目。
在每个记录中,候选笔记与BGE-M3检索,再由BGE-reranker-v2-m3 Chen等(2024)重新排行榜,由MM-指导,从而先订购更相关的笔记.
排名列表随后被过滤,以避免重复这些字段中已经声明的信息;当没有合适的注释存在后,R R被留空.

blocks.en:
Institutional descriptions ( d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} ) vary across categories in both presence and length (Figure 3 b).
They are therefore not treated as ground-truth object descriptions: the field is frequently empty, and when present, it does not reliably reflect a complete account of the object.
blocks.zh:
机构说明(d ref d^{\-mathrm{ref}}-)在存在和长度上都不同(图3b).
因此,它们不被视为地面真实物体描述:字段常常是空的,当存在时,它不能可靠地反映物体的完整描述.

blocks.en: 4 Availability
blocks.zh: 4 可用性

blocks.en:
CHICO is publicly available for research use.
Construction and analysis code is released in the heritage-data-hub repository. 3 3 3 https://github.com/AI-Unicamp/heritage-data-hub The dataset is deposited on Zenodo Oliveira and Costa (2026) .
The deposit includes the catalog records, train/validation/test splits, image URLs with checksums for verification, and documentation.
An optional archive provides the contextual enrichment notes.
Image files are not redistributed; they can be retrieved from the recorded URLs and checked against the provided checksums, subject to each record’s copyright and reuse terms.
blocks.zh:
CHICO公开供研究使用.
建筑和分析代码发布在遗产数据库中。 3 3 3 https://github.com/AI-Unicamp/heritage-data-hub 数据集存于Zenodo Oliveira和Costa (2026)上。
押金包括目录记录、火车/验证/测试分解、带有核查核对和的图像URL以及文档。
一个可选的档案提供了背景丰富的注释.
图像文件不重新分配;它们可以从记录的URL中取出,并与提供的校验和核对,但须遵守每个记录的版权和再利用条件。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
As a fixed research sample derived from openly licensed Europeana records with associated media, the dataset should not be considered representative of the broader Europeana collection.
The requirement for successfully decoded images influences the sample composition, favoring providers whose media links resolve to decodable images over those that lead to viewer pages, packaged scans, or unavailable content.
blocks.zh:
数据集作为一个固定的研究样本,取自具有相关媒介的公开许可的欧洲a记录,不应被视为代表更广泛的欧洲a收集。
对成功解码图像的要求会影响样本的构成,有利于媒体链接到可解码图像的提供者,而不是导致取景者页面、被包扫描或无法获取内容的提供者。

blocks.en:
The dataset partitions link related records through exact matches of identifiers, image URLs, and cryptographic hashes.
Visually similar images already present in the collection typically receive different hashes and are therefore not treated as related, so such near-duplicates may still appear across splits.
Additionally, the broad item categories used in the dataset analysis are derived from heterogeneous catalog type values and may not fully represent the original classifications.
Contextual enrichment draws only on notes of related entities referenced by each record.
blocks.zh:

收藏中已经存在的可视相近的图像一般会接收不同的散列,因此不被视为相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相

内容上的丰富只取自每一记录所引用的相关实体的笔记。

blocks.en:
Although CHICO was originally developed to support evidence-grounded description generation, this release focuses on dataset construction and characterization.
Its potential use in other applications, including multimodal retrieval and metadata enrichment, remains to be evaluated.
blocks.zh:
虽然CHICO最初是为了支持以证据为根据的描述生成而开发的,但这一发布侧重于数据集的构建和特征化.
其可能用于其他应用,包括多模式检索和元数据浓缩,仍有待评估。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Sparse and heterogeneous catalog records in cultural heritage aggregators make it difficult to assemble multimodal evidence for reproducible research.
This work addresses that gap with a fixed research sample of 60,397 Europeana records that brings together curated catalog fields, verified images, and contextual notes while preserving the original records and their provenance.
The construction yields predefined splits that group related records and a multimodal structure that retains the institutional description separately for comparison.
The dataset is characterized by its composition, languages, and catalog-field coverage across collections, along with documentation of its construction.
Code and data are publicly available, providing a reusable foundation for evidence-grounded description generation and related multimodal research on cultural heritage collections.
blocks.zh:
文化遗产汇总器中的分层和分层目录记录使得难以收集多种模式的证据以供再生研究。
这项工作利用60 397个欧洲记录的固定研究样本弥补了这一差距,这些记录汇集了整理的目录域、经核实的图像和背景说明,同时保留了原始记录及其出处。
施工结果预先界定了该组相关记录的分拆,并保留了单独进行比较的机构说明的多式结构。
该数据集的特点是其组成、语言和目录域覆盖各集,以及其构建的文件。
守则和数据可供公众查阅,为基于证据的描述的生成和文化遗产收藏的相关多模式研究提供了一个可重复使用的基础。
